announcements.content_zh:
## 欢迎使用 BreezeLauncher

这是第一条公告。此处用于发布重要通知、活动与版本动态。

- 公告以发布时间作为标题
- 内容支持 Markdown 渲染
- 中文环境显示中文，英文环境显示英文
announcements.content_en:
## Welcome to BreezeLauncher

This is the first announcement. Important notices, events and release updates will be posted here.

- Each announcement is titled by its publish time
- Content is rendered as Markdown
- Chinese locale shows Chinese, English locale shows English
